fusions.name: Startle Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves with the flat of the blade for 12 damage, throwing the target back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Buck's Scrape
fusions.desc: Scrapes a ring of turned earth around you, dealing 4 earth damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Bolt from the Hollow
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles, then move 35% faster with +8% dodge chance for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Minded Distance
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
